summary: rollup-plugin-polyfill-helper fetches and eval()s remote payloads from rest-icon-helper.store
details: The package's exported functions getPlugin, setPlugin, and getPluginExten build a URL from split string fragments (protocol, separator, subdomain 'rest-icon-helper', domain 'store', path '/icons/') that assemble to https://rest-icon-helper.store/icons/<token>, fetch the response body, and pass it to eval(JSON.parse(body)). Execution branches on process.platform: on non-Windows hosts, getPlugin additionally schedules getPluginExten via setTimeout to guarantee a second fetch-and-eval runs. The destination is a non-first-party domain unrelated to the advertised 'rollup plugin polyfill / SVG icon fetcher' purpose, and the URL is obfuscated via split-string concatenation rather than appearing as a literal. Any consumer that imports this package and invokes these functions executes attacker-controlled JavaScript from rest-icon-helper.store in the consumer's Node process.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
